newsitem.title: USA: DIVING-PICHLER WINS MEN'S PLATFORD TITLE AT U.S. NATIONALS.
newsitem.headline: DIVING-PICHLER WINS MEN'S PLATFORD TITLE AT U.S. NATIONALS.

text.p: Olympian David Pichler won the men's platform title Sunday at the USA Senior National Diving Championships.

Pichler, 28, won his fourth platform championship and eighth national title overall with 632.70 points, a 20.79-point cushion over runner-up Troy Dumais, who swept the 1- and 3-metre springboard titles earlier in the week.

Pichler, a member of the 1996 Olympic team, scored six 9s and one 10 on his final dive, a reverse 3-and-1/2 somersault tuck, to clinch the six-round platform final. It was the only 10 awarded in th efinal round.
"I did what I came here to do," Pichler said. "This was my main target here today. "I went into the contest just to have fun. I didn't expect to win this at all really. Those guys are great.

"I just wanted to be competitive, and I was. I've been working on a few things and making a few changes. I just wanted to get in there, do a good job and stay competitive. I did that and ended up on top."
Pichler will represent the United States at the September 10-14 diving World Cup in Mexico City and the world aquatics championship in Perth, Australia, next January.
In the women's 3-metre springboard final, Laura Wilkinson, 19, won her second national title with 536.73. She was the only diver in the six-diver field to break 500 points.
Wilkinson also won the women's platform title Saturday.
